item.title: Show HN: Carolina Cloud Nextflow
item.summary: Nextflow is an orchestration platform not entirely unlike Kubernetes, Slurm, Snakemake and others. It is quite popular in the bioinformatics community. Some details: -Uses gVisor containers -Reuses input file with "host locality" -10% faster than AWS HealthOmics -First-class support for LLMs If you're into bioinformatics, or just curious about how biologists are using compute, please check it out! Link to launch post: https://carolinacloud.substack.com/p/nf-ccloud-launch-what-i... Link to benchmarking post: https://carolinacloud.substack.com/p/nf-ccloud-launch-benchm...
